audience: marketing and events teams that send or hand out gift rewards with Giftbit

useCases.title: Browse reward brands for a region
useCases.text: List the regions, then list the reward brands of one region with their allowed prices. Read the terms of one brand.

useCases.title: Check rewards and their redemption status
useCases.text: List the rewards ordered through the API, with recipient and redemption status. Open one reward by its uuid, or one order by its id.

useCases.title: Check the account balance
useCases.text: Read the account balance by currency before an order. Adding funds is not offered here, so use the Giftbit web interface for that.

useCases.title: Email one reward to a recipient
useCases.text: After the user approves the brand, the price and the message, order one email reward for one recipient. Production charges the account. Testbed emails the account owner instead.

useCases.title: Create shortlink rewards for an event
useCases.text: Order shortlink rewards to hand out yourself. Read the claim URLs once they are ready, shortly after the order.

useCases.title: Cancel a reward that nobody has claimed
useCases.text: Cancel a reward after the user approves it. The recipient must not have claimed it, and embedded rewards cannot be cancelled.
